instalado_texto:
PipeEditor {version} is installed and will load every time you open Maya.

You'll find it in the PipeEditor menu in Maya's menu bar.
cmd_cable_clic: PipeEditor: draw a cable by clicking on surfaces
cmd_tuberia_clic: PipeEditor: draw a pipe by clicking on surfaces
cmd_cable_seleccion: PipeEditor: cable between the selected objects or points
cmd_tuberia_seleccion: PipeEditor: pipe between the selected objects or points
cmd_hornear: PipeEditor: bake the selected cables and pipes
crear_clic_ayuda: Each click on a surface adds a point. Ctrl+click starts another. Ctrl+Z removes the last point. Q (select tool) finishes.
crear_seleccion_ayuda: One span between each selected object, vertex, face or locator and the next, in selection order.
crear_grupos_ayuda: Select faces or vertices on two objects: one cable is created per pair, with slightly different slack and thickness.
crear_aristas_ayuda: Select a row of connected edges on a model; the cable or pipe follows it and updates if you move the model.
crear_curva_ayuda: Select one or more NURBS curves; each one gets a cable or pipe that follows it live.
pegar_objetos_ayuda: Anchors are parented to the object they are created on and follow it when it moves.
estilo_borrar_elige: First choose the style you want to delete from the list.
estilo_de_serie: Styles that ship with PipeEditor can't be deleted.
editando_uno: Editing the selected cable or pipe
estado_tenso: {n} spans are taut: they have no slack left.
estado_sin_seleccion: Select a cable or pipe to edit it, or create a new one.
campo_perfil_cable_ayuda: Cable shape: round, twin (lamp cord), flat (ribbon), braided (rope), corrugated (hose), coiled (phone cord) or chain (thickness is the link wire).
campo_perfil_tuberia_ayuda: Pipe shape: round, square (duct), corrugated (flexible) or insulated.
campo_grosor_ayuda: Diameter of the cable or pipe.
campo_lados_ayuda: Sides of the cross-section. Fewer sides, fewer polygons.
campo_segmentos_metro_ayuda: Resolution along the cable: how many straight segments per metre.
campo_pared_ayuda: Wall thickness. With open ends the pipe looks hollow.
campo_holgura_ayuda: How much longer than a straight line the cable is. 0 % is taut.
campo_modo_tension_ayuda: Fixed slack: always hangs in proportion. Fixed length: keeps the current length and goes taut if you pull the ends apart.
campo_salida_ayuda: Straight section along the surface direction before it starts to hang or turn.
campo_apoyar_suelo_ayuda: If the cable hangs lower than the floor, it lies on it.
campo_recorrido_ayuda: How it goes from one point to the next: along surfaces (from a wall to the floor it runs down the wall and along the floor, where supports can go), Z (half, turn, half), L (longest axis first), straight, or around the support objects with as few elbows as possible, staying close to the wall.
campo_radio_codo_ayuda: Elbow radius, in pipe diameters. 0 leaves sharp corners.
campo_codo_ayuda: Bent, or with a fitting (coupling) on each side.
campo_conector_inicio_ayuda: Part at the first end of the cable.
campo_conector_fin_ayuda: Part at the last end of the cable.
campo_extremos_ayuda: Open (the wall shows), capped or flanged.
campo_separacion_bridas_ayuda: Distance between flanges on straight runs. 0 = no flanges. With flanges, they also go on both sides of every elbow.
campo_separacion_soportes_ayuda: Clamps that reach the nearest wall (see “Walls for supports”). 0 = no supports.
campo_alcance_soportes_ayuda: Maximum distance to the wall for a support.
campo_haz_ayuda: Several cables together along the same route.
campo_torsion_ayuda: How much the bundle's cables twist.
campo_separacion_bridas_haz_ayuda: Plastic cable ties that hold the bundle. 0 = no ties.
apoyos_ayuda: Select the cable and the objects: the cable rests on them instead of passing through. With no objects, removes the supports.
paredes_ayuda: Select the pipe and the walls or ceilings: supports stretch to the nearest surface.
conector_propio_ayuda: Select the cable and an object modelled with its Y axis pointing where the cable comes out.
insertar_punto_ayuda: Select an anchor: adds another halfway along the next span.
quitar_punto_ayuda: Removes the selected anchors (each cable keeps at least two).
seleccionar_anclas_ayuda: Selects all anchors of the selected cables.
seleccionar_cuerpo_ayuda: Selects the mesh of the selected cables (to assign another material, for example).
hornear_ayuda: Turns the selected ones into plain Maya meshes. They can no longer be edited with PipeEditor, but the scene opens in any Maya.
borrar_ayuda: Deletes the selected cables or pipes with all their anchors.
clic_instrucciones: Click: add point · Ctrl+click: start another · Ctrl+Z: remove last · Q: finish
clic_falta_uno: Click where the first span ends.
falta_seleccion_dos: Select at least two objects, vertices, faces or locators.
falta_grupos: Select faces or vertices on two different objects.
falta_aristas: Select a row of connected edges.
falta_curva: Select one or more NURBS curves.
falta_cable: Select a cable or pipe first.
falta_cable_y_objetos: Select the cable or pipe, then the objects.
falta_cable_y_objeto: Select the cable, then the object to use as connector.
conector_puesto: Custom connector set on both ends.
horneados: {n} baked: they are now plain meshes.
aviso_guardar: This scene has {n} live PipeEditor cables or pipes.
aviso_guardar_texto: PipeEditor: the scene has {n} live cables or pipes. To open it in a Maya without PipeEditor (for example on a render farm), save a baked copy (PipeEditor menu > Save a baked copy…) or bake them all.
campo_arriba_ayuda: Which way is “up” in your scene. Cables hang the other way.
campo_reposo_ayuda: If the cable touches the floor or an object, or runs through a hook, it finds where it settles with its real length: it lies down, falls over edges and passes through nothing.
campo_rigidez_ayuda: How hard it is to bend. 0 % is a slack rope; 100 % a thick, stiff cable with wide curves.
campo_ondulacion_ayuda: Coil memory: gentle side waves, like a freshly unrolled cable.
campo_variacion_ayuda: In a bundle without ties, how much the slack changes from one cable to another.
campo_semilla_ayuda: Swaps the waviness and variation for others just as natural. The same number always gives the same result.
gancho_ayuda: Turns the chosen points into hooks: the cable slides through them without being tied, sharing its length between both sides. Press again to tie them.
gancho_si: The cable runs through these points without being tied.
gancho_no: The cable is tied at these points again.
campo_norma_ayuda: Free: the thickness you set. With a standard, diameter and wall snap to the nearest commercial tube: steel DN, copper EN 1057, PVC pressure, PVC drainage, multilayer or ANSI Schedule 40 steel.
campo_soportes_auto_ayuda: Places supports at the spacing used in installation: about 1.8 m for thin tubes and up to 5 m for thick ones.
campo_tubos_ayuda: Several pipes together, as in a rack: in a row, evenly spaced, with concentric elbows.
campo_separacion_tubos_ayuda: Distance between the axes of two neighbouring pipes. 0 = automatic (a bit more than their thickness).
estado_sin_reposo: No physical rest: this Maya has no numpy. The cable hangs as a catenary and rests without physics.
escena_migrada: PipeEditor: {n} cables or pipes from an earlier version; they stay as they were.
fijar_forma_ayuda: Stores the cable's current shape and stops computing it: it no longer changes when support objects move or when the scene opens, and it's much lighter. If you move an end, the shape stretches to it. Press again to release it.
fijado_si: Shape frozen: the cable is no longer recomputed.
fijado_no: Cable released: it is computed again.
falta_cable_vivo: Select a cable created with anchors first (not from a curve).
cmd_copia_horneada: PipeEditor: save a copy of the scene with everything baked, for rendering on another computer
copia_horneada_hecha: Baked copy saved ({n} cables or pipes): {ruta}
copia_no_deshecha: Couldn't restore the scene after saving the copy. Use Edit > Undo.
campo_pendiente_ayuda: Horizontal runs drop by this percentage from the first anchor towards the last, like a drain (1 to 2 % is typical). The drop is made up in the last vertical run.
campo_soportes_hacia_ayuda: The nearest surface (wall), hung from the ceiling on a rod, or standing on the floor. Increase the reach if the ceiling is far.
campo_senales_ayuda: Flow direction arrows and colour bands to identify the fluid, on straight runs. They use the Parts material.
derivar_ayuda: Select an anchor on the pipe, then the object, face or point the branch goes to: adds a tee at that anchor and a new pipe from it.
accesorio_ayuda: Select pipe anchors and choose what goes there: valve, tee or reducer. A reducer in the middle makes the pipe thinner from there on; at an end, it leaves a thinner outlet.
falta_ancla_tuberia: Select anchors of a pipe (the yellow locators).
falta_derivar: Select an anchor on the pipe, then where the branch goes.
cmd_lista_materiales: PipeEditor: save the bill of materials of the selection (or the whole scene) as CSV
campo_viento_ayuda: Sways freely hanging cables, with gusts that change with scene time (for animation). Resting or frozen cables don't move.
campo_direccion_viento_ayuda: Where it blows, in degrees on the ground (0 = towards +X). A cable running along the wind barely moves.
